P-2002-03629.title: Accelerating Feedforward Computation via Parallel Nonlinear Equation Solving
P-2002-03629.claim: The authors recast feedforward computation (RNN backprop, DenseNet, autoregressive sampling) as nonlinear equations solved by Jacobi/Gauss-Seidel fixed-point iteration, matching sequential outputs while reporting 2.1-26x speedups.
P-2002-03629.transfer_caveat: Original models and tasks differ from frozen Huginn/Ouro recurrent KV, and the exact-iteration guarantee holds only at full convergence, not under early-stop cost.
P-2002-03629.notes: arXiv ID resolved; title matches wiki card title. Card read from heonniy/research-wiki (read-only). Caveat adapted from card transfer_links/scope. Listed in references/by-target/C-PAR-001.md as methodological_analogy.

P-2305-16317.title: Parallel Sampling of Diffusion Models
P-2305-16317.claim: ParaDiGMS guesses future denoising states and refines them in parallel with Picard iterations, reporting 2-4x sampling speedups without measurable quality loss.
P-2305-16317.transfer_caveat: A diffusion time-step solver does not verify Transformer next-token or future per-depth KV fidelity.
P-2305-16317.notes: arXiv ID resolved; title matches wiki card title. Card read from heonniy/research-wiki (read-only). Caveat adapted from card transfer_links/scope. Listed in references/by-target/C-PAR-001.md as methodological_analogy.

P-2309-12252.title: Parallelizing non-linear sequential models over the sequence length
P-2309-12252.claim: The authors parallelize nonlinear sequential models (RNNs, Neural ODEs) over sequence length with a Newton-style fixed-point/root solve, reporting up to ~1000x GPU speedups.
P-2309-12252.transfer_caveat: The dynamics are over sequence time, not same-token recurrent depth, and Jacobian solve/memory costs differ from a frozen LM core with KV cache.
P-2309-12252.notes: arXiv ID resolved; title matches wiki card title. Card read from heonniy/research-wiki (read-only). Caveat adapted from card transfer_links/scope. Listed in references/by-target/C-PAR-001.md as methodological_analogy.

P-2309-16318.title: DeepPCR: Parallelizing Sequential Operations in Neural Networks
P-2309-16318.claim: DeepPCR casts a sequence of neural operations as an equation system solved by Parallel Cyclic Reduction, reducing cost from O(L) to O(log L) and reporting up to ~30x forward / ~200x backward MLP speedups.
P-2309-16318.transfer_caveat: Parallel reduction requires an exploitable operator system; there is no pretrained looped-Transformer KV benchmark.
P-2309-16318.notes: arXiv ID resolved; title matches wiki card title. Card read from heonniy/research-wiki (read-only). Caveat adapted from card transfer_links/scope. Listed in references/by-target/C-PAR-001.md as methodological_analogy.

P-2402-02057.title: Break the Sequential Dependency of LLM Inference Using Lookahead Decoding
P-2402-02057.claim: Lookahead Decoding uses Jacobi-style token trajectory speculation with parallel verification to produce identical outputs, reporting up to 1.8x on MT-bench and up to 4x with multi-GPU scaling on code completion.
P-2402-02057.transfer_caveat: It parallelizes the token axis, not recurrent depth, and exact verification needs extra target computation.

P-2402-09970.title: Accelerating Parallel Sampling of Diffusion Models
P-2402-09970.claim: ParaTAA recasts diffusion sampling as triangular nonlinear equations solved with a training-free accelerated (Anderson-like) fixed-point iteration, cutting inference steps 4-14x, and matching a 100-step DDIM Stable Diffusion sample in 7 steps.
P-2402-09970.transfer_caveat: Diffusion sampling consistency differs from BF16 causal recurrent KV and long rollouts.
P-2402-09970.notes: arXiv ID resolved; title matches wiki card title. Card read from heonniy/research-wiki (read-only). Caveat adapted from card transfer_links/scope. Listed in references/by-target/C-PAR-001.md as methodological_analogy.

P-2412-08292.title: Self-Refining Diffusion Samplers: Enabling Parallelization via Parareal Iterations
P-2412-08292.claim: SRDS applies Parareal (coarse solve refined by parallel fine solves) to pretrained diffusion samplers, converging to the serial solution with up to 1.7x speedup at 25 steps and 4.3x on longer trajectories.
P-2412-08292.transfer_caveat: Parareal needs a cheap yet accurate coarse propagator, and none is yet known for pretrained Huginn.
P-2412-08292.notes: arXiv ID resolved; title matches wiki card title. Card read from heonniy/research-wiki (read-only). Caveat adapted from card transfer_links/scope. Listed in references/by-target/C-PAR-001.md as methodological_analogy.

P-2505-24791.title: Accelerating Inference of Discrete Autoregressive Normalizing Flows by Selective Jacobi Decoding
P-2505-24791.claim: The authors apply Jacobi decoding selectively to layers of discrete autoregressive normalizing flows with redundant dependencies, reporting superlinear convergence and up to 4.7x faster inference without quality loss.
P-2505-24791.transfer_caveat: Autoregressive normalizing flows are not looped Transformers and have different convergence constraints.
P-2505-24791.notes: Page showed v2 revised 4 May 2026; card version field says only 'arXiv abstract'. Listed in references/by-target/C-PAR-001.md as methodological_analogy.

P-2508-16817.title: Predictability Enables Parallelization of Nonlinear State Space Models
P-2508-16817.claim: The authors tie the largest Lyapunov exponent (predictability) to the conditioning of parallel Newton-style evaluation, showing predictable systems parallelize in at worst O((log T)^2) while unpredictable ones converge too slowly.
P-2508-16817.transfer_caveat: The theory's assumptions and global Lyapunov exponents are not established for Huginn, where only local perturbation ratios have been measured.
P-2508-16817.notes: arXiv ID resolved; title matches wiki card title. Card read from heonniy/research-wiki (read-only). Caveat adapted from card transfer_links/scope. Listed in references/by-target/C-PAR-001.md as methodological_analogy.

P-2510-24824.title: Parallel Loop Transformer for Efficient Test-Time Computation Scaling
P-2510-24824.claim: The Parallel Loop Transformer evaluates different loop iterations for different tokens concurrently (shared first-loop KV plus gated sliding-window attention), reportedly matching looped accuracy with little added latency/memory over a non-looped model.
P-2510-24824.transfer_caveat: It changes which token states are available at each depth and is trained with that architecture (shared first-loop KV is not a drop-in policy for existing Huginn/Ouro checkpoints), and FLOPs still grow with loop count.
P-2510-24824.notes: Card read at full_text depth by the wiki (checked 2026-11-11); my own verification depth is wiki_card+abstract. Read references/by-target/C-PAR-001.md: this paper is NOT listed there (card links to C-KV-002/C-REC-002 instead).

P-2511-01465.title: A parallel-in-time Newton's method-based ODE solver
P-2511-01465.claim: The authors solve nonlinear ODEs as a root-finding problem via Newton's method and parallelize the linearized recursion with parallel scans, claiming logarithmic span and runtime gains over Parareal.
P-2511-01465.transfer_caveat: General ODE dynamics lack attention-KV semantics, and the linearized operator cost may dominate on a GPU decoder.
P-2511-01465.notes: arXiv ID resolved; title matches wiki card title. Card read from heonniy/research-wiki (read-only). Caveat adapted from card transfer_links/scope. Listed in references/by-target/C-PAR-001.md as methodological_analogy.

P-2512-14681.title: Fast and Accurate Causal Parallel Decoding using Jacobi Forcing
P-2512-14681.claim: Jacobi Forcing progressively distills an AR LLM on its own Jacobi decoding trajectories, reporting ~3.8x wall-clock speedup (~4.0x with multi-block rejection recycling) on coding/math with little quality loss.
P-2512-14681.transfer_caveat: It requires post-training, which our no-training setting forbids, and decodes along the token axis rather than recurrent depth.

P-2605-17842.title: SNLP: Layer-Parallel Inference via Structured Newton Corrections
P-2605-17842.claim: SNLP treats layer-by-layer Transformer computation as a nonlinear system solved with parallel Newton-style updates using cheap surrogate Jacobians, reporting up to 2.58x speedup at 0.5B scale.
P-2605-17842.transfer_caveat: It targets trained ordinary layer-stack Transformers; no quality-preserving speedup is established for frozen Huginn/Ouro.
P-2605-17842.notes: Card says the 2.3x / 6.1% PPL figure is for a specially trained 0.5B Nanochat; the abstract fetch summary reported up to 2.58x and a milder 1.40x setting (possibly v3 vs. earlier version); card text may be stale relative to v3. Listed in references/by-target/C-PAR-001.md as methodological_analogy.

P-2609-01924.title: Looped Transformers under the Jacobian Lens: Does the Global Workspace Survive Recurrence?
P-2609-01924.claim: The authors extend the Jacobian lens to looped transformers (Ouro, Huginn), finding a workspace-like band in the repeated block whose interventions must span all later loops in Ouro but only a ~2-recurrence window in Huginn.
P-2609-01924.transfer_caveat: This is an interpretability study, not a parallel-inference method; a workspace probe differs from an attention-KV intervention, and a lens failing to carry information does not prove the model loses it.
P-2609-01924.notes: Not a parallelization paper; relevant as evidence on cross-loop dependence in Huginn/Ouro. Card was read at full_text depth by the wiki. Read references/by-target/C-PAR-001.md: this paper is NOT listed there (card links to C-KV-002/C-REC-002 instead).

P-2610-35556.title: LoopFold: Parallelizing Recurrent Depth in Looped Transformers
P-2610-35556.claim: LoopFold trains a predictor and corrector so later recurrent depths of the same token prefix run in parallel stages, reporting 46% lower decoding latency and higher accuracy than a nine-loop vanilla 1.4B model.
P-2610-35556.transfer_caveat: The predictor, corrector and backbone are jointly trained, and no unchanged Huginn/Ouro checkpoint is evaluated, so it does not show training-free parallel-in-depth works.
P-2610-35556.notes: Not independently checked beyond arXiv abstract page (submitted 26 Oct 2026); card read at full_text depth by the wiki. Read references/by-target/C-PAR-001.md: this paper is NOT listed there (card links to C-KV-002/C-REC-002 instead).
